main_text.p: gitime Patriarcha fuerat creatus: reduxitque in locum Photij Ignatium a Barda iniuste pulsum. Itaque Ecclesiis Dei tranquillitatem restituit. Nec ab his recentiores Græci diffident Dorotheus Metropolita Monembasiensis [?] in Synopsi Historiarum. Ὁ ἡ Βασιλεὺς ἐβγαλε Φώτιον τὸν Πατριάρχην μὴ Ἀ[?]χρεσπικῆς Σωσθὸν [?], ὡς ὧδε ἁμάρτημα, ὅπου ἐλαβε τὸν Θεῖον ὀδίκως, καὶ ἔβαλε πάλιν τὸν νόμον Πατριάρχῳ Ἰγνάτιον τὸν ἡγασμένον, ὅπου ἐβγαλεν ὁ Βαρδὰς ἀδίκως καὶ ἁμαρτωλῶς. Imperator vero eiecit Photium Patriarcham cum Archieratica Synodo uti legis transgressorem, qui iniuste Sedem occuparat, & rursus restituit legitimum Patriarcham sanctum Ignatium, quem Bardas iniuste, & contra fas omne eiecerat. Eadem habet Matthæus Cigala Cyprius. Adde his, post hanc Synodum ordinationes Photij nullas reputatas fuisse a Græcis, & Romanæ Sedis iudicio sefe submisisse, & ab ea dispensationem petijsse: Leo Imperator, Synodum a se Constantinopoli coactam ita alloquitur, Ἐ᾽ν ὀφθαλμῷ ἡ μᾶλλον πεσωφωνῷ τῶν ὑμετέρων ἀλλήλοις, ἵνα σωτηρίαν πρὸς ἀλλήλους [illegible, ~14 letters] μία πίμπνη· ἐν ἡ αὐτὸ τῆς Ῥωμαίων τῆς ἀσφαλείας ἡ ἀκολούθη σωτηρίαν τῶν ἀδελφῶν μὲ δὲ τὸ χρεστῶν Διάκονον τῶν Φωτίου, ὅπου ἐμ ὀφθαλμῶν ὁμοῦ προσφυγεῖν εἰς τὴν Ῥώμην πρὸς τὴν Πάπαν, καὶ

page.notes: Page 36 of the printed book. Greek passages are uncertain in several places: the opening of the Greek sentence, the word after "Σωσθὸν", the "Ἀ" before "χρεσπικῆς", and the end of the quotation from Leo, where the scan is too faint to read reliably. Marked words are only the uncertain ones; the rest is copied as seen. "Monembasicnsis" was read as "Monembasiensis" with a doubt. The first line starts mid-sentence, so the first paragraph is marked as a continuation.
